info.title: Traigent Backend Content Identity Routes
info.description: Content identity v1 routes (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md; Backend milestone M3): the tenant purpose-key grant the SDKs need to mint example ids, the server-computed identity of a hosted dataset version, root-to-version resolution, and the per-dataset public-benchmark opt-in (ruling D3). Declared ahead of the Backend merge: each operation is x-asserted-against-backend false until the Backend branches (feat/content-identity-key-custody, feat/content-identity-dataset-root) land on develop with parity tests.

post.summary: Issue the caller tenant's content-identity purpose keys
post.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/content_identity_routes.py issue_purpose_keys. The tenant is the auth stack's binding (get_current_tenant_id), never a header or the body. Same permission as creating an optimization session (experiment.write); an API key stating a foreign X-Tenant-Id frame is answered 404. Every grant is audited (CONTENT_IDENTITY_PURPOSE_KEYS_ISSUED, kid only); a grant that cannot be audited is not issued (503). Rate limited per route (defaults 2/s, 30/min, 600/h, 5000/day). Excluded from the idempotency replay cache so key material is never persisted.
post.x-traigent-body: No request body is read; any body sent is ignored.

200.description: The grant itself, BARE (not a success envelope): exactly PurposeKeyGrantV1. SECRET key material: never cache, log or persist.

403.description: Missing experiment.write, or no tenant context. The no-tenant-context branch is a BARE body {"error": "tenant_context_required"} (no success, no message), sent with Cache-Control: no-store.

404.description: An API key stated a foreign tenant frame (X-Tenant-Id differs from the key's tenant): the route is hidden, not refused.

429.description: Route rate limit exceeded (error_code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, details.scope content_identity_purpose_keys).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry may succeed.

503.description: Keys unavailable: custody not configured, a stored master that fails a custody check (the internal reason -- e.g. wrap_scheme_mismatch, wrapping_key_ref_mismatch, tenant_id_not_derivable -- is logged and never sent), or the grant's audit record could not be written. BARE body {error: content_identity_keys_unavailable, message}, sent with Cache-Control: no-store; SDKs degrade to key_status unavailable. A rate limiter that cannot evaluate answers 503 with the (masked) canonical error envelope instead.

get.summary: Get a hosted dataset version's server-computed content identity
get.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py get_dataset_version_content_identity. Read access to the dataset (project viewer) through the owner-scoped parent load. Returns the identity under the tenant's ACTIVE key (root, counts, members_ref and the per-example map), re-verified on every read; or status unavailable with a reason. The version object (DatasetVersionV1) is unchanged.

200.description: The version's content identity (status available) or why there is none (status unavailable). An integrity failure is status unavailable, reason stored_identity_mismatch, never a 5xx with a partial identity.

403.description: Dataset read access or project viewer role denied.

404.description: Dataset not found in the caller's owner scope, or the version is not a version of that dataset.

get.summary: Resolve a dataset_root to the caller's dataset versions
get.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py get_dataset_versions_by_root. Tenant from the canonical context; each match filtered through the owner-scoped parent dataset load.

parameters.name: dataset_root
parameters.description: A MultisetRootV1 (msr1:<kid>:<64 hex>). The Backend's route variable is named root.

200.description: The readable versions with that root, newest first.

403.description: Dataset read access or project viewer role denied, or no tenant context.

404.description: No version the caller may read has that root (indistinguishable from an unknown root).

put.summary: Set or clear the dataset's public-benchmark opt-in (ruling D3)
put.description: TraigentBackend src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py set_dataset_public_benchmark. Requires dataset write access and project editor role, THEN tenant owner/admin (or platform admin) membership; API-key principals are refused even when the key's owner is a tenant admin. A refusal is audited (ACCESS_DENIED, reason tenant_admin_required); a change is audited (DATASET_PUBLIC_BENCHMARK_CHANGED) and not applied if the audit write fails. The Backend also emits the flag as public_benchmark on the dataset read (Benchmark.to_dict); dataset_schema.json is closed and does not declare it yet -- adding it is a separately acknowledged contract change (breaking_schema_check classifies it property_added on a closed schema).

400.description: public_benchmark missing or not a boolean.

403.description: Dataset write access or project editor role denied, or the caller is not a tenant owner/admin (error_code FORBIDDEN), or the principal is an API key.

404.description: Dataset not found in the caller's owner scope.

500.description: The change or its audit record could not be written; nothing was applied.
